method.importance: mean absolute standardized coefficient across 20 cross-fitted models, normalized to sum to one
method.riskApproximation: 0.65 mean-loss coefficient + 0.35 P90-loss coefficient before output clamping
method.interpretation: positive coefficients raise predicted economic loss; negative coefficients reduce predicted economic loss
method.limitation: correlated transformed features share or exchange coefficient importance; these are predictive associations, not causal effects
